text:
Warframe: Tau - Official Gameplay Demo | TennoCon 2026
Take a look at a gameplay demo for Warframe: Tau, Warframe's next major narrative chapter. Reach beyond the bounds of the Origin System and venture into a new Star Chart, the Tau System. Once a paradise built by the Sentients, Tau has been lost to war and ruin. Nowhere is this felt more keenly than on the black rain-soaked streets of Fornax, a colossal Sentient ring city. Here, the devastating downpour and its maddening influence run in rivulets from the heights of the Hunra's gambling dens, through the Docks, and into the most desperate Slums — where the residents have turned to the mind-altering Bloom in search of escape.
There, Albrecht Entrati awaits the arrival of the Tenno after conscripting the inner monologuing and noir-inspired Warframe, Brysko, to infiltrate the Hunra's criminal underworld — a final gamble to avert Fornax falling to those with nothing to lose. Get ready to risk it all.

text:
Agefield High: Rock the School – Official Release Date Trailer
If Rockstar won't make Bully, then dang it, developer Refugium Games is going to give it their best college try. Or in this case, high school try, as Agefield High: Rock the School puts you in high school in the early 2000's in a coming-of-age adventure. It will be released for PC on August 12. It'll hit consoles later. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3562580/Agefield_High_Rock_the_School/

text:
The Odyssey: Tom Holland, Anne Hathaway, and Robert Pattinson on Breathing New Life Into a Classic
We talked to Tom Holland, Anne Hathaway, and Robert Pattinson, who play Telemachus, Penelope, and Antinous in Christopher Nolan's latest movie, The Odyssey. With plenty to talk about, including Greek mythology, working with Nolan, and debating whether Antinous really is that bad a guy, this one goes off the rails a little...

The Odyssey hits theaters July 17, 2026.

Soulframe - Official Warsongs Trailer | TennoCon 2026
Take a look at a brand new trailer showcasing the latest for Soulframe, including a new Warsongs Fable which features a corrupted player progression path, a fishing mini-game, and the long-anticipated mount system. Soulframe is coming soon to PC (Steam), with the Preludes Early Access for PC available now.

Total War: Warhammer 40,000 - Gameplay Video | BiliBili World 2026
Take a look at gameplay from Total War: Warhammer 40,000 shown to players at Bilibili World 2026. In the 41st Millennium, battles rage in every corner of the Galaxy. Forces are in orbit around a civilised world in the Armageddon theatre, under threat by an ongoing invasion of Orks. The governor of this planet has requested aid, and the Astra Militarum have joined the defence.
